t: Bostik S41 Neutral Cure Window & Door Frame Silicone is a professional-grade neutral cure silicone sealant, developed for sealing window and door frame joints. It helps prevent and fix issues related to mould and damp such as leaking or damp windowsills or doorways, making it ideal for both new installations and remedial work. Low modulus sealant suitable for interior and exterior applications and offers up to 25% movement capability. Certified for low emissions, and is both UV and weather-resistant.
b: Suitable for Use with Most Building Substrates
